The season began on 30 January and is scheduled to end on 6 December 2026.{{cite web |last1=Catalán |first1=Javier |url=https://www.adnradio.cl/2025/11/24/con-nuevo-torneo-y-futbol-de-enero-a-diciembre-anfp-fija-las-fechas-para-el-inicio-de-las-competencias-de-2026/ |title=Con nuevo torneo y fútbol de enero a diciembre: ANFP fija las fechas para el inicio de las competencias de 2026 |trans-title=With a new tournament and football from January to December: ANFP sets the dates for the start of the 2026 competitions |language=es |publisher=[[ADN Radio Chile|ADN Radio]] |date=24 November 2025 |access-date=3 December 2025}}{{cite web |last1=Viluñir Silva |first1=JP |url=https://redgol.cl/chile/todo-listo-anfp-le-pone-fecha-al-inicio-de-la-temporada-2026-de-la-liga-de-primera |title=Todo listo: ANFP le pone fecha al inicio de la temporada 2026 de la Liga de Primera |trans-title=Everything set: ANFP sets a date for the start of the 2026 Liga de Primera season |language=es |publisher=RedGol |date=12 December 2025 |access-date=12 December 2025}} [[Coquimbo Unido]] are the defending champions. == Format changes == Although the competition kept its usual double round-robin format with teams playing each other twice for a total of 30 matchdays, changes were made to the distribution of international berths due to the introduction of a new competition named [[Copa de la Liga (Chile)|Copa de la Liga]] starting from this season. The Liga de Primera champions and runners-up will still qualify for the group stage of the [[2027 Copa Libertadores]], whilst the team placing third in the league will face the [[2026 Copa Chile]] champions in a play-off match for a berth into the Copa Libertadores second stage. The teams placing from fourth to sixth will qualify for the [[2027 Copa Sudamericana]], with the loser of the play-off match between the third-placed team and the Copa Chile champions being entitled to claim the last Copa Sudamericana berth.{{cite web |last1=Zúñiga |first1=Alfonso |url=https://redgol.cl/chile/oficial-consejo-de-presidentes-aprueba-copa-de-la-liga-2026-y-redistribuye-cupos-internacionales |title=Oficial: Consejo de Presidentes aprueba Copa de la Liga 2026 y redistribuye cupos internacionales |trans-title=Official: Council of Presidents approves 2026 Copa de La Liga and redistributes international slots |language=es |publisher=RedGol |date=14 October 2025 |access-date=3 December 2025}} == Teams == {{location map+ |Chile |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2026 Liga de Primera teams. |places= {{location map~ |Chile |lat=-26.25 |long=-69.616667 |label=
